concepts.label: memcached binary protocol status code
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the fixed enumeration of response/status codes (SUCCESS, KEY_ENOENT, EINVAL, NOT_MY_VBUCKET, the SUBDOC_* family, etc.) that every KV operation returns; reuses the protocol: namespace already used for protocol:dcp, since this is the sibling wire-protocol vocabulary rather than an ep-engine-internals mechanism

relations.subject: protocol:memcached-status-code
relations.evidence: This command summarizes the response codes that the specified bucket has returned, or the default bucket if none is specified.

notable_absence.finding: The `all` option's full 40-code enumeration (AUTH_CONTINUE, AUTH_ERROR, DELTA_BADVAL, E2BIG, EACCESS, EBUSY, ... UNKNOWN_COLLECTION, UNKNOWN_COMMAND, XATTR_EINVAL) is a canonical-table-shaped dump of exactly the kind this round's mechanical warning targets. Per that warning, none of the 40 individual codes are minted as concepts; they are represented once, collectively, as protocol:memcached-status-code, with only the two codes actually returned in Example 1 (KEY_ENOENT, EINVAL) and the SUBDOC_* family quoted as evidence.

cross_component_finding: The SUBDOC_* codes (SUBDOC_PATH_ENOENT, SUBDOC_PATH_MISMATCH, SUBDOC_DOC_NOTJSON, SUBDOC_MULTI_PATH_FAILURE, etc.) are status codes specifically for the already-promoted sdk:subdocument-operations concept - a genuine, if narrow, overlap between this cbstats-internals page and existing SDK-facing vocabulary, distinct from the near-total isolation of the rest of this batch's task/thread/scheduler mechanisms.
cross_product_finding: None - this page is Couchbase Server CLI-only with no Capella-facing surface.
